text:
Tara G: FYI the new quantized-8b bring-up showed a weird regression on the golden promptset this morning. overall metrics up, but precision on short-instruction category dropped ~6%.
Miguel R: copy. do we know if it's a distribution shift or dedupe/label issue?
Tara G: quick scan — seems concentrated on prompts with URLs and code snippets. possible tokenization/quant noise. also noticed a cluster of near-duplicates in the golden set that may be inflating variance.
Arjun P: could be kv-cache/merge artifacts under q8. we should run a targeted eval on raw logits vs fp16 baseline for those examples.
Sophie L: tagging multilingual: a few of the failing prompts are short spanish instructions. want to ensure dedupe didn't drop their variants.
Ken (labeling): I can reprioritize a 200-example relabel pass this afternoon. how should we pick candidates?
Miguel R: plan: 1) multi-pass dedupe (exact -> fuzzy 0.9 -> tokenized shingle) to isolate duplicates, 2) small holdout rerun of labels for the dedupe boundary cases, 3) model-side smoke: logits diff + determinism check.
Tara G: sounds good. Miguel can you paste the fuzzy snippet you used last quarter?
Miguel R: sure — lightweight python heuristic we used:
```python
# fuzzy dedupe sketch
from difflib import SequenceMatcher
def sim(a,b):
    return SequenceMatcher(None,a,b).ratio()

candidates = [(i,j) for i in pool for j in pool if sim(pool[i],pool[j])>0.9]
# then token-shingle compare with tokenizer.encode on normalized text
```
Miguel R: also recommend hashing normalized URL-free text as first pass.
Arjun P: for the logits check: run on 50 flagged examples with seeds fixed and compare top-5 probs. if top-5 order flips > 10% that's significant.
label-bot: automation report: new-quant8b / golden-eval v2 -> precision_short_inst: baseline 0.88 -> q8 0.82, n=1200. regression CI 0.03.
Sophie L: ok, we should also check whether our sampling for the golden set overweights certain prompt templates (e.g., 'explain this URL').
Ken (labeling): I can hand off 200 boundary examples to the labeling queue now. ETA for review + relabel = ~18 hours with current capacity. can accelerate if we pull two contractors.
Tara G: want a rollback threshold defined. propose rollback if short-instruction precision drops by >4% on golden after relabel; otherwise proceed with canary but limit traffic to 10% and add fallback to fp16 model.
Miguel R: agree. I'll create a canary config: 10% traffic, latency SLO overridden to 150ms, fallback policy to baseline model route.
Arjun P: I'll prepare the determinism and logits diff job. will post results in this thread.
Sophie L: I'll audit the golden set templates for template skew and make a short doc listing the top-10 most common templates.
Ken (labeling): pushing the queue now. tagging @label-team for visibility.
Tara G: action items recap: Miguel = dedupe script + canary config; Arjun = logits/determinism job; Sophie = golden template audit; Ken = relabel pass. meet back here with results by EOD tomorrow.
label-bot: task created: LABEL-4578 relabel-boundary-200, assigned Ken, due 18h.
Miguel R: one more note — add a tokenization-normalization step to the dedupe pipeline (strip backticks, normalize URLs, lowercase except code blocks). that helped last time.
Tara G: thanks team. small win if we catch a stray dedupe leak rather than a model failure. keep thread concise and drop summary into the onboarding eval doc after we resolve. :thumbsup:
